dialogs.about: 다락에서 낡은 장난감 상자를 손자와 열어 보며

lines.en: Grandma, what is in this old box?
lines.ko: 할머니, 이 오래된 상자 안에 뭐가 있어요?

lines.en: These are toys from my childhood.
What is this small round thing?
That's a marble. I played with marbles long ago.
Did you make this kite too?
My brother made it for me long ago.
Wow! Grandma, I want to fly this kite.
lines.ko: 우와! 할머니, 이 연을 날리고 싶어요.

lines.en: This box brings back happy memories.
lines.ko: 이 상자를 보면 행복한 기억이 떠올라요.

lines.en: I will take the kite to the playground.
Then I will push you on the swing.

dialogs.about: 놀이터 앞에서 옛 친구와 어린 시절 이야기

lines.en: Hello! Do you remember this old playground?
Of course. This place holds my best memories.
We rode that swing every day long ago.
Do you see the children with the kite?
Yes. That little baby is watching them.
lines.ko: 네. 저 작은 아기가 아이들을 보고 있어요.

lines.en: This place reminds me of my childhood.
lines.ko: 이곳은 내 어린 시절을 떠올리게 해요.

lines.en: Did you keep your old marbles?
I lost them many years ago.
I will bring my granddaughter here tomorrow.
That's nice. Thank you for talking with me.
